description: FortiClient fortips.sys Cryptolibrary v3.0 - The fortips.sys library provides the following services for the FortiClient product: HMAC, SHA1, AES CBC, AES ECB, 3DES. Fortips.sys is a kernel mode device driver that appears as a "Fortinet Virtual Adapter" in the network interfaces list.
